cards.title: Core idea
cards.body: A system design interview asks you to design a large system such as a URL shortener or chat app out loud in about 45 minutes. There is no single right answer; you are judged on how you handle an open problem and explain trade-offs.

cards.title: How it works
cards.body: Structure: clarify functional and non-functional requirements, estimate scale with back-of-the-envelope math, define the API, sketch the high-level design, deep-dive the hardest parts, then discuss bottlenecks, failure modes and trade-offs. State assumptions out loud.

questions.q: Should you start drawing right after hearing the problem?
questions.a: No. Designing before clarifying is the most common way to fail; scope and scale change the design.
Capacity estimation, then API design, then high-level design.
